sources.snippet: The M1 Pro is a scaled up variant of the M1 chip, featuring more powerful and numerous CPU and GPU cores. Additionally, by using LPDDR5 memory at a higher frequency, memory bandwidth increased to 200GB/s. [6] The M1 Max is a higher-powered version of the M1 Pro with a larger die size.
